objective: Measure the model-KLD effect of each frozen layer-63 candidate expert and identify which accepted refits contribute to the complete panel's lower point estimate.
evidence_boundary: The 16 public 512-token documents already measured the complete layer-63 refit panel and are candidate-selection data for this plan. A singleton or later composition selected with these documents requires confirmation on a new document-disjoint reference tier.

selection_protocol.retention_rule: Retain a singleton only when candidate-minus-resident equal-document mean KLD is negative on both document groups. Rank retained singletons by the mean over all 16 documents.
selection_protocol.composition_boundary: A composition chosen from singleton results is another selection candidate and requires a new document-disjoint confirmation tier.
